title: libcuflynx calibration workflow (calibration_workflow.json)
description: Ordered calibrations of module instances -- typically a supermodule's submodules, then the supermodule -- each against its own instance's obs_data and params_for_id, merged into the parameters of one supermodule instance (the target). Run with cuflynx-calibration-workflow or libcuflynx.calibration_workflow.run_calibration_workflow. The checks that need the module library (the instances exist, each step's module sits in the target, no parameter is calibrated by two steps) are in libcuflynx/calibration_workflow/resolve.py; the rest are in spec.py as well as here.

target.description: the supermodule instance the calibrated values are merged into. Defaults to the instance whose directory holds the file.

module_library_dirs.description: module libraries, relative to this file; more can be given on the command line

module_type.description: the module type (a module config entry's module_type)

settings.description: user_inputs settings for the calibrations (a step's are merged over the workflow's, one dict level deep). The model, obs_data, params_for_id and output directories are chosen by the workflow and cannot be set.

oneOf.description: a step id; its stored distribution, as the default kind (mvnormal)

step.description: the step whose stored distribution is used (it must set store_distribution)

kind.description: how the stored samples are represented: a multivariate normal, independent normals, or a kernel density estimate, each on a scale on which the parameter bounds are unbounded

inflate.description: multiplies the distribution's variance, to temper an overconfident earlier posterior

parameters.description: only these parameters (model names in the source step), not all of them

id.description: unique step id; also the step's output directory name

target.description: the instance this step calibrates, against its own <instance>_obs_data.json and <instance>_params_for_id.csv

submodule.description: where the module sits in the workflow target (a submodule name, or nested names joined by _). Inferred when the module type and version occur once.

depends_on.description: steps that run before this one

fixed_from.description: earlier steps (in depends_on, directly or not) whose calibrated values, and the values they were given as fixed, are fixed in this step's model

priors_from.description: earlier steps whose stored distributions become priors here: their parameters are calibrated again in this step, with that prior

store_distribution.description: after the fit, sample the posterior by MCMC (needs UQ_options) and store it (chain, samples, stats) for later steps and tools
